text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Runtime alert: repeated CUDA OOMs + container exits on rwd-prod-usw2 (interval 12m). Crash count=9. Auto-restart triggered.

samir: i'm taking pager. seeing a cluster-wide uptick in restarts and 5xxs for streaming endpoints. removing worst offenders from rotation.

emma_sre: metrics: hosted-api/us-west2 streaming error rate jumped to 18% at 04:18 UTC. p95 latency doubled. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/hosted/usw2-streams

nikhil_rt: logs are consistent across nodes: paged-attn allocator fragmentation rising, kv-cache retained_pages steadily increasing, defrag attempts failing to reclaim. sample: 
```
[2026-03-28T04:16:58Z] paged-attn WARN: fragmentation_ratio=0.82 slabs=kv-cache
[2026-03-28T04:16:58Z] kvcache DEBUG: retained_pages=950MB active_streams=76
[2026-03-28T04:16:59Z] runtime ERROR: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY when allocating 64MB device=0
```

nikhil_rt: pattern: long-lived streaming sessions pin attention pages + KV entries; eviction/defrag can't free hot pages fast enough -> slow memory creep -> OOM during bursts.

samir: immediate actions: 1) mark top-3 noisy nodes OUT 2) trigger cluster-wide eviction job 3) reduce max_stream_context to 3k for region us-west2 4) route new long-context sessions to fallback small-model pool 5) request extra capacity (+2 GPUs)

ops-bot: rwd-prod-usw2-node-3 removed from LB (by samir). rwd-prod-usw2-node-6 removed from LB (by samir).

cs_rep: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported reconnects and truncated streams (tickets: E-4021, E-4022). notifying account teams.

emma_sre: running eviction now and bumping allocator defrag interval to 3s via ops endpoint.

nikhil_rt: running commands: 
```bash
# force eviction across us-west2
curl -XPOST http://ops.internal/kv/force-evict?region=us-west2
# increase defrag loop
curl -XPOST http://ops.internal/allocator/defrag?interval=3s
```

samir: rolling a hotfix flag to reduce kv.slab.active to 5 on a canary subset to force smaller slab usage for new sessions. will ramp if metrics look good.

emma_sre: canary results: 10% traffic -> error rate dropped from 18% to 6% on canaries. proceeding to 50%.

nikhil_rt: note: defrag and eviction are band-aids. root cause is bitmap fragmentation in paged-attn allocator; we need a compaction path that can coalesce free runs. i've got a prototype but it needs safety checks.

ops-bot: capacity request accepted. provisioning +2 GPU nodes (eta ~6m).

emma_sre: after canary ramp and eviction, cluster error rate down to 3%, p95 improving. a few older containers still OOMing (didn't pick up eviction).

samir: performing staggered container restarts (batch size 4) to clear stale allocations without causing a traffic surge.

nikhil_rt: collected heap/allocator traces from affected containers; uploading artifacts to /artifacts/incidents/3887654321/allocator_traces.tar.gz and heap_samples/.

cs_rep: sent interim customer note: "We observed transient streaming failures; routing and eviction mitigations are in effect; engineering investigating a permanent fix."

emma_sre: impact window estimate: 04:12-04:28 UTC (approx 16m). ~150 failed streams, highest error rate at 04:18.

samir: status update: mitigations applied, error rate ~0.7%, remaining unstable node (node-9) isolated. moving to investigation.

oncall-next: Handoff -> i'll take coverage at 06:00 UTC. Summary for next oncall: 
- Incident synopsis: paged-attn allocator + kv-cache fragmentation caused gradual retained_pages growth -> CUDA OOMs and container crashes in us-west2 streaming pool.
- Actions taken: isolated bad nodes, forced eviction, increased defrag frequency, reduced max_stream_context flag, rolled kv.slab.active hotfix, added +2 GPUs, staggered restarts.
- Customer impact: ~150 failed streams across 2 enterprise customers, peak error rate 18%, recovered to <1% post-mitigation. Tickets: E-4021, E-4022.
- Artifacts: /artifacts/incidents/3887654321/allocator_traces.tar.gz, heap_samples/, logs/oom_snippets.log
- Next steps: implement allocator bitmap compaction with backpressure, add long-stream sustained load CI tests, alert on retained_pages > 700MB for >8m.
- Owner for follow-ups: nikhil_rt (compaction PR), emma_sre (CI + alerts), oncall-next (postmortem write-up).

nikhil_rt: i will schedule a short spike to harden compaction and run it behind a feature flag; target: safe roll in 2 weeks.

emma_sre: creating postmortem doc and linking artifacts. will include loadtest changes and alert thresholds.

inc-bot: Incident INC-3887654321 -> RESOLVED (metrics stable). Moved to postmortem backlog.
